title.en: Co-operative Societies (Modification of Co-operative Societies Rules under Section 97) Order 2014

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Co‑operative Societies (Modification of Co‑operative Societies Rules under Section 97) Order 2014 and shall come into operation on 6th August 2014.

heading.en: Modification of rule 6 of Co-operative Societies Rules 2009

text.en: 2. Rule 6(1) of the Co‑operative Societies Rules 2009 (G.N. No. S 349/2009) shall, in its application to the Singapore National Co‑operative Federation Limited, be modified to the extent that the Singapore National Co‑operative Federation Limited shall change its auditor at least once every 6 years, either to another auditor from the same auditing firm or company or to another auditor from a different auditing firm or company.
